answer: Each identity must prove in zero knowledge it harbors a distinct credential over two years old without naming it. A nullifier binds each credential to one identity, a bridge from off-chain history to on-chain identity. A reused nullifier, forged proof, or credential waking from its nadir triggers enforcement: the 25.000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half to the challenger, and that credential is banned for good. 1.000 fakes cost 25.000 x 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA plus 1.000 credentials; an honest agent stakes 25.000 POA once. Limitation: newcomers lacking aged credentials are locked out.
